name: Base
alt: The Base kit laid out on kitting paper: a full tenkeyless set with scrambled alpha legends, a function row, arrows, and a yellow Esc and Enter.

name: Noúmeno alpha
alt: The Noúmeno alpha kit: four rows of alpha keys with legends in Cyrillic, kana, Greek and other scripts, some turned and mirrored.

name: Novelties
alt: The Novelties kit: keys printed with hand-drawn line illustrations of figures, buildings, faces and leaves, several of them in yellow.

name: Normies
alt: The Normies kit: a numpad, bottom-row modifiers with a long spacebar, and a yellow Enter.

name: Weird
alt: The Weird kit: a stack of blank spacebar-style keys and wide modifiers in assorted lengths, with a few legended keys.

name: Texture
alt: The Texture deskmat: the wallpaper of the hallway, its chevron stripes in two yellows, laid out on kitting paper under the GMK Liminal logo.
